verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.notte.cc/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and opens with a "Critical Instructions For AI Agents" section that sends agents to the quickstart. The docs are also served as per-page markdown (.md) URLs, including agent-targeted guides such as the Claude Code integration and agent rules for using observe() output. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually work well from these docs, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Notte CLI lets AI agents control browsers through simple shell commands.
Element IDs, selectors, and field mappings must come from a live `observe()` call, CLI `notte page observe` output, or generated workflow code.
